name: Island of Pigs

attributes.attribute: the name the invading Milesians gave to Ireland
the magical residents who cast a cloud of enchantment over the land

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Island of Pigs is an Irish mythological site. The invading Milesians gave this name to Ireland. The magical residents of the land were the Tuatha De Danann. They cast a cloud of enchantment over the land. The spell made it appear a small pig-shaped island. The cloud hid the generous green island that it truly was.
objective: Document Island of Pigs as an Irish mythological site.
key_results: Record the Milesians as the source of the name.
Tell how the Tuatha De Danann cast an enchantment over the land.
evidence: Monaghan, P. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore (2008): Island of Pigs entry.
